pools.title: Cost pools
pools.description: What self-hosted backends and subscriptions cost: each hour’s cost is shared among that hour’s turns on the pool’s backends by weighted tokens; hours without turns are idle capacity. Pools are the workspace’s, whatever the filters. Subscription pools are estimates.
pools.gpu: By GPU time: no meter yet
pools.none: No cost pools yet. Add one for a self-hosted backend (its hardware, power, hosting) or for ChatGPT subscriptions.

pool-form.name: Name
pool-form.metered: Metered: its cost comes from meter readings (power, for one)
pool-form.amount_metered: US dollars a unit (unless a reading says)
pool-form.months: Write off over months (a purchase; empty for a running cost)
pool-form.no-backends: No backends yet: add one on the Platform page.
pool-form.weights: Token weights for sharing an hour

readings.title: {{name}}: meter readings
readings.description: Each reading is what was used since the one before (or since the pool started), spread evenly over that time.

sync.title: Price sync
sync.on_one: On: once a day Socio reads providers’ and community price lists and keeps the prices of the {{count, number}} model in use. The requests carry nothing about this workspace.
sync.on_other: On: once a day Socio reads providers’ and community price lists and keeps the prices of the {{count, number}} models in use. The requests carry nothing about this workspace.
sync.off: Off: Socio reads no price lists, and turns are priced only by the prices it already has and admins’ own.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: US dollars per million tokens. A turn takes its provider’s price in force when it started: an admin’s from its date onward, then the provider’s own list, then a community list. Provider * holds for every provider, such as a self-hosted one.
prices.none: No prices yet. Turn the price sync on, or add a price.
